title: Patch: the AI prices a Field Spell's Death, as it already prices a Unit's

**Issue #2687 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2687: Patch: the AI prices a Field Spell's Death, as it already prices a Unit's
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
Some Field Spells pay out when they are destroyed: Comet Crash gives you random Resources as it crumbles a turn after you play it, Bauble Bubble gives two Stockpiles, Job Application and The Narcor Project have their own payouts. The practice AI counts what a Unit leaves behind when it dies, but not what a Field Spell does, so it sees these cards as their cost and nothing more and rarely plays them; the AI's own card sweep already flags Comet Crash as almost never played. Once built, the AI counts a Field Spell's Death on the board on both sides and in its hand, as it does for Units, so it plays these cards and values destroying the opponent's.

## Why
- §6.2: Death is a backrow card's too, and the engine fires it there (`crates/engine/src/state_check.rs:1128-1139`).
- Five Field Spells have a `death` hook: Bauble Bubble `classicplus-061`, Comet Crash `stinkyscape-155`, Job Application `stinkyscape-112`, The Narcor Project `stinkyscape-039` and Frostspatula `classicplus-012-8` (every script with `death: Some`, read against `crates/cards/catalog.json`'s types).
- `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs:1237-1249` (`death_prices`, R2424000): the candidates are `active_units_of` on both sides and the hand's `CardType::Unit` cards only.
- `material`'s readable backrow branch (`evaluate.rs:755-781`) adds the turn hook price (R2477000, R2565000) and the Activate price (R2603000), but no `death_price`, while `unit_worth` adds it (`:388`).
- `crates/ai/src/shadow_ban.rs:1007`: Comet Crash is at risk, “affordable on 17 turns over 8 games, played 1 time(s), mean evaluate change -0.1”; The Narcor Project at `:791`, “never played” on pass 1.

## Proposal
- In `death_prices`, after the field's units, list each readable backrow card on either side whose Death is live (`death_hook_of`), and the seat's own hand Field Spells with one, spawned onto the backrow as `spawned_turn_hook_probe` spawns them (factor the spawn out and share it); keep R2424000's order, its node budget `AI_DEATH_PROBE_NODES` and the dedupe by `DeathPrice::is_for`.
- In `material`'s readable backrow branch add `w.death * death_price(...)` outside the Brittle share, as `unit_worth` does (a Brittle crumble is a destroy).
- A face-down enemy card is never priced (R351, R185).
- A ruling in this issue's block extending R2424000, with `spec/pending/<issue>.md`; re-run `cargo jackioh gate`, and the sweep if the gate's numbers move.

## Where it lands
- `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`; tests in `crates/ai/tests/ai/deaths.rs`
- `spec/rulings/R<n>.md`, `spec/pending/<issue>.md`; SPEC §6.2, §9.9

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] On a board where nothing else is worth doing, the AI with Comet Crash or Bauble Bubble in hand and the mana for it plays it.
- [ ] A Field Spell with a live Death on the AI's backrow is worth more to it than the same card with its Death removed; an enemy one is worth more to destroy.
- [ ] An enemy face-down card's Death is never probed (two states that differ only in which trap sits face-down price the same).
- [ ] Tests named after the new ruling, listed in its `proven_in`; `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`, clippy, `cargo jackioh gate` and `cargo jackioh spec check` pass.

## Size and risks
Medium (hard by CLAUDE.md rule 11, the AI): about 50 lines and tests. Risk: more probes per decision; they share `AI_DEATH_PROBE_NODES`, so the budget does not grow. The Narcor Project pays only on a Brittle destroy, so a sandbox destroy may price it at nothing; that is correct and should be a test, not a fix.

## Plan

_Written by `gpt` (codex, `gpt-5.6-sol`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41322958816)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Extend the decision-root Death pricing from Units to readable backrow cards on both sides and the AI's hand Field Spells, without increasing `AI_DEATH_PROBE_NODES`, changing deduplication, or reading a hidden enemy card. Make the priced Death contribute outside a backrow card's Brittle share, so Comet Crash and Bauble Bubble are played for their payout, readable enemy/own Field Spells are valued for it, and The Narcor Project's non-Brittle sandbox destroy correctly prices at zero.

## Files to touch

| Path | Status | Change |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs` | change | Extend `death_prices`, share a Field Spell hand-spawn helper with `spawned_turn_hook_probe`, and add `death_price` in `material`. |
| `crates/ai/src/config.rs` | change | Update `EvalWeights::death` and `AI_DEATH_PROBE_NODES` documentation without changing either value. |
| `crates/ai/src/decide.rs` | change | Update the root-price pass contract comment for backrow/hand Field Spell Deaths. |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/deaths.rs` | change | Add R2687000 coverage for hand/board Field Spells, decisions, hidden cards, ordering/budget, and Narcor Project. |
| `crates/ai/README.md` | change | Extend the Death-price contract from Units to readable backrow cards and hand Field Spells. |
| `spec/09-architecture.md` | change | Amend §9.9 Evaluation with the same scope and hidden-information/budget behavior. |
| `spec/rulings/R2424000.md` | change | Mark the original Unit-only Death ruling as extended by R2687000. |
| `spec/rulings/R2687000.md` | new | Define the Field Spell/backrow extension and list the proving test file. |
| `spec/pending/2687.md` | new | Add issue #2687's pending §11 paragraph. |

Do not touch `crates/engine`, `crates/cards` (scripts, catalog, or patches), any app under `apps/`, other `crates/ai` files, generated files, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, or `bot/`; do not change any value in `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, add a patch fragment, or edit `spec/INDEX.md`/`spec/11-rulings.md`. The governing text is SPEC §6.2 Death and §9.9 Evaluation, R185/R351 (hidden backrow), R2424000/R923001/R923003 (Death probes and spawning), R2565000 (readable backrow/hand spawn precedent), and R2603000 (Brittle placement precedent).

## Steps

1. In `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`, extract the Field Spell branch currently inside `spawned_turn_hook_probe` into `spawn_hand_field_spell(world, seat, card, counter) -> Option<Option<(GameState, CardInstance)>>`. Preserve its exact behavior: use `first_entry_zone(..., Row::Backrow)`, spend one sandbox node on `SandboxOp::Spawn`, keep the requested definition/radiant face, return the card at that slot, and return `Some(None)` for a full backrow/refused spawn. Reuse it from `spawned_turn_hook_probe`.
2. Generalize `spawned_death_probe` in the same file: Unit calls `spawn_hand_unit`; Field Spell calls `spawn_hand_field_spell`; both pass the spawned card to `death_probe`; all other types return `Some(None)`. Rename the `unit` parameters/locals of `death_probe` and `death_price` to `card` where they now serve both kinds (the Rust types/signatures otherwise stay the same), update unit-only comments, and cite R2687000 alongside R2424000.
3. Extend `death_prices` candidates in the fixed order: active Units controlled by `seat`, active Units controlled by its opponent, readable (`readable_by`) non-standing cards in `seat`'s backrow then the opponent's backrow, then the seat's hand Units and Field Spells. Require a live `death_hook_of` for the Death pass, retain the existing second Starship-Piece pass, `DeathPrice::is_for` dedupe, sandbox setup, early exits, and the one `AI_DEATH_PROBE_NODES` sub-counter. Mark only hand entries for `spawned_death_probe`; never inspect/probe an unreadable enemy backrow card.
4. In `material`'s `Some(def) if readable_by(...)` branch, add `w.death * death_price(state, card, w, prices)` outside `brittle_share`, beside the turn-hook price. Explain that Brittle crumble is a destroy, so its Death payout survives the body's Brittle discount. Keep face-down cards in the existing opaque-cost branch.
5. Update the module header and relevant `DeathPrice`, `death_price`, `Prices`, probe, and material comments in `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`. In `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, extend the `EvalWeights::death` comment to cover `material`'s outside-Brittle backrow share and the `AI_DEATH_PROBE_NODES` comment to count two nodes per board candidate, three per hand Field Spell/ordinary hand Unit, and four for a hand Unit that first clears a full row, without changing `death: 0.5`, `GREEDY_EVAL.death: 0.0`, or the 24-node constant. In `crates/ai/src/decide.rs`, cite R2687000 in `plan`'s root-prices comment and say the Death set includes the readable boards and own hand Units/Field Spells. Update the Death paragraph in `crates/ai/README.md` and SPEC §9.9's Evaluation paragraph in `spec/09-architecture.md` with the same order, spawn, budget/dedupe, outside-Brittle material contribution, and face-down exclusion.
6. In `crates/ai/tests/ai/deaths.rs`, add constants for Bauble Bubble (`classicplus-061`), Comet Crash (`stinkyscape-155`), Job Application (`stinkyscape-112`), The Narcor Project (`stinkyscape-039`), the same-cost face-down Traps Sheepish (`core-041`) and My Pawn (`core-096`), and Permanent Underclassman's granted Death key (`meditative-058#bookDeath`). Add `sides(seed, p1, p2)` by copying `crates/ai/tests/ai/turn_hooks.rs::sides` so new cases can name both fields/backrows while receiving the existing Vanilla library; add `backrow_card(state, player, def_id)`, `eval_with(state, deaths)`, and `close(a, b)` helpers. Extend the file-level description from Unit-only Deaths to the R2687000 backrow/hand behavior. Add the exact tests listed below, using `Prices { deaths, ..Default::default() }`, `evaluate_priced`, and the existing `priced`/`price_of` patterns.
7. Add `spec/rulings/R2687000.md` with `id: R2687000`, title `"The AI's evaluation prices a readable backrow card's Death and an own hand Field Spell's (issue #2687)"`, `cards: "§6.2, §9.9, R82, R185, R186, R345, R351, R1081000, R2424000, R2565000, R2603000, R923000, R923001, R923003; C+ #12.8, #61; Stinkyscape #39, #112, #155"`, and `proven_in: crates/ai/tests/ai/deaths.rs`. Specify ordering, spawn behavior, controller-relative destroy-minus-remove pricing, outside-Brittle material contribution, unchanged budget/dedupe, exclusions, the zero Narcor Project result, and rejected hidden probing/new budget. Append an “Amended by issue #2687 ([[R2687000]])” paragraph to `spec/rulings/R2424000.md`.
8. Add `spec/pending/2687.md` with the single bold §11 paragraph for R2687000 (issue #2687, 2026-11-01), summarizing the old Unit-only gap, new candidates/material term, unchanged budget, and R185 hidden-card exclusion; name edits to R2424000 and §9.9. Do not run `cargo jackioh spec index`.

## Tests

In `crates/ai/tests/ai/deaths.rs`, add:

- `r2687000_a_readable_field_spell_death_counts_for_its_controller_on_either_backrow`: use Job Application face-up, clone each own/enemy state and set that backrow instance's `vanilla = true` to remove its Death without changing definition/cost, and prove the live own copy raises the priced AI evaluation while the live enemy copy lowers it by exactly `AI_EVAL.death * price` versus the Vanilla copy.
- `r2687000_a_hand_field_spell_is_priced_by_spawning_it_in_the_backrow`: put Bauble Bubble in the AI hand, assert a positive price and at least spawn/destroy/remove nodes, bounded by `AI_DEATH_PROBE_NODES`.
- `r2687000_decide_plays_comet_crash_and_bauble_bubble_when_affordable`: loop over `(COMET_CRASH, 2)` and `(BAUBLE_BUBBLE, 1)`; for each use `sides` with only that card in the AI hand, its exact mana, no field/backrow, and only Vanilla filler in the opponent hand/libraries. For RNG cursors 0 and 1, assert `decide` chooses `ActionBody::Play` with the Field Spell hand instance id rather than End Turn.
- `r2687000_an_enemy_face_down_card_is_never_probed_and_changes_no_price`: start with enemy Sheepish and set its instance's `grants` to `Some(vec![Grant { grant: "meditative-058#bookDeath".to_string(), radiant: false, params: Default::default() }])`; clone the state and change only that hidden instance's definition to My Pawn (both cost 1 Traps). Assert both `priced` results are the same empty vector with zero nodes; filtering after `death_hook_of` or probing either hidden definition would fail this.
- `r2687000_the_narcor_project_only_pays_when_brittle_destroys_it`: put it face-up with live Death, assert it is probed but its ordinary sandbox destroy price is exactly zero.
- `r2687000_field_spell_deaths_follow_units_and_share_the_existing_budget`: build one state with own Trigor, enemy Training Dummy, own Bauble Bubble backrow (plus a duplicate Bauble Bubble in hand to prove `DeathPrice::is_for` dedupe), enemy Job Application backrow, Comet Crash in hand, and own After Burner Starship Piece. Assert the priced definition order is `[TRIGOR, TRAINING_DUMMY, BAUBLE_BUBBLE, JOB_APPLICATION, COMET_CRASH, AFTER_BURNER]`, all hook Deaths precede the piece-only pass, only one Bauble entry exists, and node use is at most `AI_DEATH_PROBE_NODES`; rerun with a node counter sized from the same state without the Field Spells/piece and assert only the Unit prefix is returned, proving later candidates are omitted instead of expanding the budget.

Run:

1. `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai r2687000`
2. `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`
3. `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`
4. `cargo fmt --check`
5. `cargo jackioh spec check`
6. `cargo jackioh catalog check`
7. `cargo jackioh patches check`

Do not run `cargo jackioh gate` or the sweep in this bot run; the supplied harness instructions explicitly reserve whole AI gates for daily/CI. Record any gate movement reported later instead of changing thresholds or budgets.

## Done when

- [ ] Readable backrow Deaths on both sides and own hand Field Spell Deaths are priced in the required order with existing dedupe/budget.
- [ ] Backrow material carries Death value outside Brittle, while hidden enemy cards remain opaque.
- [ ] Comet Crash and Bauble Bubble are played in the isolated affordable decision tests.
- [ ] Narcor Project's ordinary destroy probe is zero.
- [ ] R2687000, the R2424000 amendment, §9.9, pending §11 paragraph, and AI README agree and the proving tests are named/listed.
- [ ] Targeted/full AI tests, AI clippy, rustfmt, spec check, catalog check, and patches check pass; no forbidden/generated/unrelated file changed.

## Risks

- More candidates could steal search nodes or alter deterministic decisions. Preserve the existing sub-counter, candidate order, `DeathPrice::is_for`, and seeded sandbox operations; add ordering/cap assertions instead of raising `AI_DEATH_PROBE_NODES`.
- A backrow walk can leak hidden definitions. Call `readable_by` before `death_hook_of` and keep `material`'s unreadable branch free of `death_price`; prove equal hidden states.
- Standing Units in the backrow are already returned by `active_units_of`; exclude them from the backrow addition so they are not listed twice.
- The hand probe must not play the card or fire Cry; use the same sandbox spawn semantics as turn-hook pricing, and price full backrows as unspawnable.
- Narcor Project checks the Brittle-death snapshot, so a normal sandbox destroy correctly produces no payout; do not synthesize Brittle state in production code.
- Keep the crate pure and replay-neutral: this is read-only scoring on deterministic sandbox clones, with no state/wire/action format, RNG source, dependency, or client change.

## Open questions

None. The new ruling is R2687000, the first free number in issue #2687's block; this is an AI evaluation decision, not a game-rule change, so it follows the existing R2424000/R2565000 probe design.
```
